summary: V6.6 testing — 4 new surfaces: Cypher codex-aware suggest, Anime 5E CR/encounter budget kit, Mobile character PDF, Spell -> Power Bundle conversion. 12 new V6.6 backend tests in test_iter39_v66.py ALL PASS (100%). Regression on V6.5/V6.4/V6.2/V6.1: 49/49 + V6.6 12/12 = 61 passed / 1 skipped (no PDF-able char on non-BESM systems — data gap, not code bug). Frontend testids verified by source inspection: cypher-suggest-btn, encounter-designer (+ -level/-size/-difficulty/-run/-budget), encounter-slot-{n}, encounter-hazard-budget, export-mobile-sheet-btn all present. Playwright walkthrough: login works; campaign detail + character builder pages render 'Not found' in headless preview (likely auth-cookie propagation quirk — backend API auth via Bearer works perfectly in pytest). Main agent should self-validate the Playwright UI path in a real browser session.

minor.issue: Returns empty list [] for admin at the global scope — characters only surface via /api/campaigns/{cid}/characters. Not a V6.6 regression; just a design quirk worth noting for future testing agents.

integration_issues.issue: Headless Playwright sees 'Not found' on /app/campaigns/{id} and /app/campaigns/{id}/characters/new after a successful POST /api/auth/login — localStorage.access_token comes back false in the browser context, so subsequent /api/* calls 404. Works in curl/pytest (Bearer header), so the finding is scoped to Playwright's cookie-less context. Main agent should confirm live browser behavior.

critical_code_review_comments: TESTID MISMATCH vs review spec: review says testid 'spell-convert-rules-forge' but ReferenceEditor.jsx:496 emits per-row dynamic testid `spell-convert-{slug}` (e.g. `spell-convert-fireball`). This is more testable but will break any hardcoded 'spell-convert-rules-forge' selector. Main agent should align either the spec or the code.

CharacterSheet.jsx is 1348 lines and ReferenceEditor.jsx is 971 lines — both well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting ReferenceEditor's SpellConversionAtlas, PowerBundleTemplatePicker, and PowerBundleEditor into their own files.

EncounterDesigner is correctly gated on campaign.is_gm && (anime-5e|dnd-5e) in SessionView.jsx:533-536, but the review request copy says it should appear 'below MacroBar' — code mounts it after MacroBar inside the same flex column, so spec is satisfied. Just verify visually.

cypher_suggest endpoint: hint matching is exact-string (entry.name == hint). This is strict — minor typos in tone-hint lists (e.g. 'Bears a Halo of Fire' vs codex 'Bears a Halo of Fire') won't fuzzy-match. If codex name changes, suggestions silently stop firing for that row. Consider case-insensitive substring fallback.

anime5e encounter-budget: no upper-bound validation on party_level / party_size. Level > 20 gracefully clamps via _xp_budget, but negative/zero party_size is protected only by max(1, …). Consider returning 400 on absurd inputs.

rca of the issue: No P1 issues. The 'spell-convert-rules-forge' testid spec vs code mismatch is the only functional delta — code is defensible (dynamic per-row testids are more useful), but review checklist will fail a strict selector search for 'spell-convert-rules-forge'. Suggested mitigation: either add a parent wrapper with data-testid='spell-convert-rules-forge' in the SpellConversionAtlas container (spec-compliant) OR update the spec to reference the per-row pattern. Playwright auth-propagation quirk: REST login returns access_token in JSON but the frontend's axios client appears to rely on httpOnly cookies which Playwright isolates per-navigation unless sharing context — main agent should verify in a persistent browser session.
